basic_profile.bio: I'm a mom of two from Grande Prairie, Alberta, balancing my passion for classic World of Warcraft with the chaos of motherhood. I work part-time as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to manage my time between family and gaming. I love discussing decentralized systems and societal structures, hence my interest in anarchy. My typical online hours are late evenings after the kids are asleep. I'm happily married and enjoy sharing insights on parenting and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked in the field for over a decade. My interest in gaming started as a hobby in my teens and has grown into a passion. I keep up with parenting trends through online communities and self-education.
